name: PR Brief: the seeded stored brief on PR #482 and its links into Files changed
description: Deterministic (no model call) read of the stored PR Brief on the Overview tab of the seeded PR #482 (server/src/db/seed-brief.ts). Checks the verdict banner, the summary, the Risk areas with their severity label, the Review focus list, the meta line (tokens, cost, commit) and that the Intent and Blast radius cards are still there. The icon-only 'Regenerate brief' button is only focused, never clicked. The flow NEVER clicks 'Generate brief' or 'Regenerate brief' (that makes a model call). It reloads the page to prove the stored brief shows again, then clicks a Review focus item and a risk file and checks that Files changed opens on that file with the seeded line text. Absence, order, count and busy-state checks live in the PrBriefCard component tests (agent-browser has no 'is absent' wait). Assumes a freshly-seeded DB (patches and the brief come from the seed); reads only, so it can run in any order.
